compare.description: Whether to compare the current date range to a previous date range.
compare.title: Compare

compare_to.description: The date range to compare to. The value is a relative date. Examples of relative dates are: `-1y` for 1 year ago, `-14m` for 14 months ago, `-100w` for 100 weeks ago, `-14d` for 14 days ago, `-30h` for 30 hours ago.
compare_to.title: Compare To
